g.text: Formal scope: 8,390,656 packet modes, Rudin–Shapiro length 4,194,304, 24/24 checks; exact integer and Q(sqrt(2)) audit. Curves and sampled maxima are presentation data.

text.style: font-size: 3.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'Times', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b675f

g.text: Conclusion: the time integral gives a genuine heat denominator, but critical negative regularity and phase flattening can consume its shell gain. This is not norm inflation or a Navier–Stokes regularity proof.
